kpis.description_fr: AUM = principal moteur de fees BX. Croissance organique nette + valorisations + acquisitions. Cible 1500 Mds $ horizon 2027-28.
kpis.description_en: AUM = main BX fee driver. Net organic growth + valuations + acquisitions. Target $1500B by 2027-28.
kpis._verify_reason: Le 10-K indique 'more than $1.3 trillion in Total Assets Under Management as of December 31, 2025'. La valeur de 1166 Mds $ est incorrecte; la vraie valeur est 1300+ Mds $.

kpis.signal: Segment hyper-croissance Blackstone, +62.8 Mds $ FY24, moteur structurel via private credit boom
kpis.description_fr: AUM segment Credit & Insurance (BXCI) fin FY24. Croissance organique +62.8 Mds $ vs FY23, plus rapide segment Blackstone. Profite du boom private credit et reallocation insurance pool.
kpis.description_en: Credit & Insurance segment (BXCI) AUM year-end FY24. Organic growth +$62.8B vs FY23, fastest-growing Blackstone segment. Benefits from private credit boom and insurance pool reallocation.

kpis.signal: Segment historique, croissance solide +37.8 Mds $ FY24, beneficiare BXPE individual investor
kpis.description_fr: AUM segment Private Equity fin FY24. Croissance +37.8 Mds $ vs FY23 (314.4 Mds $). Inclut Corporate PE, Tactical Opportunities, BIP infrastructure, BXPE (individual investor product).
kpis.description_en: Private Equity segment AUM year-end FY24. Growth +$37.8B vs FY23 ($314.4B). Includes Corporate PE, Tactical Opportunities, BIP infrastructure, BXPE (individual investor product).

kpis.signal: Segment pilier historique, contraction FY24 due a BREIT redemptions et marked-down valuations real estate
kpis.description_fr: AUM segment Real Estate fin FY24, contraction de 336.9 a 315.4 Mds $ vs FY23. Inclut BREP (opportunistic), Core+ (BREIT, BEPIF), BREDS (debt). Reflete cycle real estate 2024.
kpis.description_en: Real Estate segment AUM year-end FY24, contracted from $336.9B to $315.4B vs FY23. Includes BREP (opportunistic), Core+ (BREIT, BEPIF), BREDS (debt). Reflects 2024 real estate cycle.

kpis.signal: Plus petit segment, BXMA = leader mondial allocator hedge funds, croissance moderee
kpis.description_fr: AUM segment Multi-Asset Investing (BXMA) fin FY24. Leader mondial allocation discretionnaire hedge funds. Inflows +11.0 Mds $ et appreciation +9.3 Mds $ offset par outflows -9.7 Mds $.
kpis.description_en: Multi-Asset Investing (BXMA) segment AUM year-end FY24. World's largest discretionary allocator to hedge funds. Inflows +$11.0B and appreciation +$9.3B offset by outflows -$9.7B.
